output_text: David Wagner, the new manager of Huddersfield Town, signed a 12-month rolling contract in November 2015, leading the team to fifth place in the Championship before beating Reading in the play-off final. His assistant Christophe Buehler has also signed a new contract. The club has signed Belgian striker Laurent Depoitre and Australia midfielder Aaron Mooy, for a club-record fee, and Chairman Dean Hoyle praised Wagner's loyalty and impact on the team's success last year.
